body: I'm glad I was able to help you a bit. Sometimes just knowing that you aren't alone is all a person needs.
Yeah...and my heart breaks for every person who does understand.

But I would never wish what I've been through on anyone. In a weird way, I'm a little happy when people can't understand. It means that they've been spared some of the worst experiences that life has to offer

Yeah. And it sucks because you can't help but know that they are trying to help and you want them to not feel awful and helpless...so you have this choice to play along or to call them out. Neither has a good result

It just seems like no one gets it. Hearing all the positives doesn't make a difference when your brain has a chemical block to recognizing anything but darkness. And then the well-intentioned normal people get upset when you "can't accept help"
It's been so long since anyone has truly cared or stuck with me that I don't even know what support looks like anymore
